remove_blank_lines_from_wikitext: remove blank lines from a WikiText formatted file and write cleaned output to a new file
random_sample_wikitext_paragraphs: randomly sample paragraphs from a WikiText file and write up to K samples to an output file
process_wikitext_103_dataset: process the WikiText-103 dataset by removing blank lines and creating debug samples for train valid and test splits
refactor_remove_blank_encoding: refactor the remove_blank function to support configurable file encodings beyond utf-8
test_random_sample_k_parameter: test the random_sample function with different K values to verify paragraph count limits
